query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.equipamentoId) as total_equipamentos,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pd.id) as total_partes,
       SUM(pd.horaKmTrabalhados) as horas_totais
FROM parte_diaria pd
WHERE pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data < '2026-05-01';
